metadata.title: Evaluating AI-generated vs. human-written reading comprehension passages: an expert SWOT analysis and comparative study for an educational large-scale assessment

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not analyze ILSA-style cognitive achievement outcomes with Plausible Values; instead, it uses Likert-scale human judgments.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states it did not apply complex survey sampling weights and used a snowball-recruited sample.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.
